name: OpenRouter Usage
description: Track OpenRouter credits, runway and spend from Orca: model comparisons, daily and monthly budgets, API key health, CSV exports and a status bar balance. Read-only; your management key stays in Orca's encrypted secret store.

cover.alt: OpenRouter Usage: one input fanning out to several models, with the title and the features Credits and burn rate, Models, API keys and Daily ledger

screenshots.alt: The Overview: credits and runway, monthly spend and projection, comparison with the preceding period, budget progress and a daily spend chart
screenshots.caption: Credits, spend comparisons and monthly budgets

screenshots.alt: A model details drawer showing total, share, requests, token breakdown, cache hit rate and a daily sparkline
screenshots.caption: A details drawer for every model

screenshots.alt: The Keys tab with per-key spend, expiring and expired key badges, near-limit warnings and UTC reset periods
screenshots.caption: Per-key spend, expiring keys and limit health

screenshots.alt: The Ledger tab: a newest-first list of days with a bar and amount, and an activity calendar
screenshots.caption: A daily ledger and activity calendar

screenshots.alt: The Settings tab with connection test, key replacement, refresh interval, alert thresholds and toggles
screenshots.caption: Verify your key and tune alerts

settings.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the worker polls OpenRouter in the background.

settings.title: Low balance alert (USD)
settings.description: Notify and warn in the status bar when credits left drop below this. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Daily budget (USD)
settings.description: Notify once per day when today's spend passes this. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Monthly budget (USD)
settings.description: Warn when actual or projected UTC-month spend exceeds this. 0 turns it off; usage is never blocked.

settings.title: Desktop notifications
settings.description: Notify when credits run low or the daily budget is passed.

settings.title: Show credits in the status bar
Status bar shows
settings.description: What the status bar item says next to your credits left.

settings.title: Count BYOK usage in spend
settings.description: Include requests made with your own provider keys in the spend figures.
